recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic blue composition featuring a close-up of a musician's hands playing an electric guitar, with bold, two-tiered sans-serif typography positioned in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the guitar neck creates a dynamic tension against the horizontal text block.
The bright white text acts as the primary focal point against the deep blue background.
The silhouette of the musician provides a dark frame on the left, balancing the open space on the right.
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting emphasizing the guitar frets and hands
Flush-left alignment for all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The guitar and hands occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, angled upwards from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white display text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the guitar neck from the bottom left up toward the hands, then jumps to the bold white text above.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open blue space in the upper right and center right to accommodate typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy to black shadows in the musician's silhouette
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for primary display text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue with extreme value shifts between deep shadows and bright highlights.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the blue background, clear of the guitar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast through weight and color; bold white display text paired with medium-weight dark subtitle text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric clarity and weight of the primary display text.
Provides a similar geometric 'O' and modern feel.
Appropriate for the subtitle text due to its humanist qualities.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast monochromatic blue image of a person's hands playing a dark electric guitar. The lighting should highlight the frets and fingers. The left side should be dominated by the dark silhouette of the player, while the right side remains a clean, mid-tone blue field.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of dark navy text in a humanist sans-serif font in the upper right. Below that, add one line of large, bold, white geometric sans-serif text in all caps. Align all text to the left.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic blue?
Is the primary text bold white and all-caps?
Is the text aligned to the left?
Is the guitar neck positioned diagonally?

postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed outside the blue spectrum
Ensure text is perfectly legible against the background
Verify the diagonal guitar neck doesn't intersect the text
Confirm the monochromatic effect is consistent across shadows and highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic [Color] + [Instrument/Subject] in Silhouette + [Geometric Sans-Serif Typography] in High Contrast.
